Backend Engineer - Logistics Platform

Responsibilities
- Build and operate APIs for order routing and tracking
- Improve latency and reliability of high-traffic services
- Own production services and participate in on-call

Requirements
Skills: Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS
Experience: 3+ years backend engineering, 1+ year with distributed systems
Must have: production ownership, CI/CD with GitHub Actions
Nice to have: logistics domain, observability tooling
